decisionsTitle: «Are kit» on a volunteer, counted as «Cu kit»; the «Voluntari» list names a role with its category
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-03,** passing on a message from the club: «ar trebui să număr pe header câți au kit, deci trebuie încă un field de „are kit"» — and, of the «Voluntari» list, that «Roluri date» and «S-a oferit pentru» printed some role names twice.

**Decision.**

- **A mark on the volunteer**, `event_volunteers.has_kit` — a boolean, not null, false by default (migration `0187_volunteer_has_kit`, expand only), so every row from before reads «no kit». It is the organizers' own logistics, not an answer of the person's: it is drawn whatever the privacy notice in force names (unlike the profile boxes, §765, and the list's tick, §821), and it is never a box of the public form — a forged one there is ignored, the public input having no such field.
- **Who.** Whoever may already change a volunteer (`canManageVolunteers`: the Organizer and the Administrators), asserted by `changeVolunteer` behind every door (BR-REQ-060-01); the Tehnic role is refused (`FORBIDDEN`) and a person of another event is not there (`NOT_FOUND`), with nothing written.
- **Where.** On each row of `/admin/volunteers`, «Are kit» is the house's one-press tick (`TickButton`, §766) in a plain form that posts the state it wants (`hasKit=1|0`), so a second press saves the same and it works with scripts off; its Server Action `setVolunteerKitAction` (`src/app/[locale]/admin/volunteers/actions.ts`) comes back to the page of the list it was pressed on, filters kept (§839), a refusal's code in the address. The helpers the event card's verbs used to read a form and come back (`localeOf`, `field`, `eventIdOf`, `backToCard`) moved, unchanged, to `admin/events/[id]/volunteer-return.ts`, a plain module both action files import. A `CheckboxField` «Are kit» with one help line is in every person's «Modifică» (the event's card and `/admin/volunteers/[id]`) and in «Adaugă un voluntar de mână» (the card and the screen), checked as saved. A ticked person's block wears the chip «Are kit», with the hanger the editor's «Kit de participare» panel wears.
- **The trail.** The row's press is `volunteer.edited` with `fields: ["hasKit"]` and the new value; «Modifică» lists `hasKit` among the boxes it changed; the hand entry's `volunteer.added` says `hasKit: true` when it was ticked. A press that finds the mark as asked writes nothing. Nobody is emailed, and the public cache is not touched: the mark is shown on no public page.
- **The counts.** «Cu kit: N» — the ticked who are not cancelled: a cancelled person is handed nothing — is a pill of the «Voluntari» strip, always said (a nought too), blind to the state, role and kit filters like the rest of the strip (§246's rule), and a link that filters to the ticked; the same words end the editor card's closed line once anyone active is ticked («0 din 3 · 1 de confirmat · Cu kit: 2»). A select «Are kit» — everyone, yes, no — joins the list's filters (`?kit=yes|no`; anything else is no filter). On the registrations list with one event in scope, «Kituri de pregătit» gets one more line, «Plus voluntari cu kit: N», only when there is any: a figure of its own (`countVolunteersWithKit`), so `countKits`, the title's figure and every registrations export read as before.
- **The files.** The event's CSV ends with «Are kit» («Da» / «Nu» in the reader's words), appended so no earlier column moves; the spreadsheet carries it right after the T-shirt's size, and the every-event workbook too. «Toate datele unei persoane» lists «Are kit» among what is kept of an offer, and its JSON carries the column (art. 15).
- **The doubled names.** One role name may stand in several categories — the club's race has «Direcționare», «Foto/Video» and «Punct de hidratare» under both «Start / Sosire» and «Traseu» (§774) — and the list printed each role by its bare name, so a person who offered both read «Direcționare, Direcționare». No join multiplied rows: a person's roles given and offered are read from their link tables, one row per pair (their primary keys), once per page. The fix is at the source query: `listRoleNames` and `listRolesWithCounts` read each role's category words, and the list prints them with `roleLabel` — «Direcționare (Start / Sosire), Direcționare (Traseu)» — as the card, the person's page, the files and the emails already did; the role select names them the same way, and a role under no category keeps its name alone.
- **Proven** on PGlite: the tick by each role, the trail, the refusals, the counts, the filter, the files, the names (`tests/integration/volunteers/kit.test.ts`), the kits' line (`tests/integration/registrations/kit-count.test.ts`), the card and the public form (`tests/unit/volunteers/kit-render.test.ts`), the migration (`tests/integration/db/volunteer-has-kit-migration.test.ts`).

**Refused.**

- **Counting the volunteers into «Kituri de pregătit»'s own figure.** That figure is the runners' — the registrations holding a place and the open invitations — and the exports and §897 read it as such; the volunteers' kits are another pile, said on their own line.
- **A tick on the public form.** Whether the club hands someone a kit is the organizers' decision, not the person's answer.
- **A question before the press** (§384): the mark tells nobody and the same tick undoes it.
- **Dropping the repeated name.** Hiding the second «Direcționare» would hide a role the person offered; the category tells the two apart.
changelogLine: - **«Are kit» on a volunteer** — the organizers tick who gets a volunteer kit: in one press on the «Voluntari» list, in «Modifică» and in «Adaugă un voluntar de mână». «Cu kit: N» on the strip (a filter too) and on the event card's closed line, «Plus voluntari cu kit: N» under the registrations' «Kituri de pregătit», an «Are kit» column in the CSV and Excel; and the list names a role with its category, so «Direcționare» under two categories no longer reads twice. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Migration `0187_volunteer_has_kit` is expand-only: it adds `event_volunteers.has_kit`, a boolean, not null, false by default, so every row from before reads «no kit» and a row written without it too (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given `/admin/volunteers`, then each row carries «Are kit» / "Has a kit", a one-press tick (`TickButton`: a submit with `role="checkbox"` and `aria-checked`) in a plain form posting the state it wants and the page's `returnTo`; when the Organizer or an Administrator presses it, then `event_volunteers.has_kit` takes that state, one `volunteer.edited` audit row names `fields: ["hasKit"]` and the new value, a press that finds the mark as asked writes nothing, no email is queued, and the press comes back to the same page of the list, filters kept (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the Tehnic role, or a volunteer of another event, when `setVolunteerKitAction` is posted, then it is refused — `FORBIDDEN` / `NOT_FOUND`, the code in the address it comes back to — and nothing is written: the role is asserted by `changeVolunteer`, never by the page alone (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a person's «Modifică» (the event's card, `/admin/volunteers/[id]`) or «Adaugă un voluntar de mână» (the card, the screen), then a `CheckboxField` «Are kit» / "Has a kit" with one help line is drawn whatever the privacy notice in force names, checked as saved; its save is audited (`hasKit` among the fields of `volunteer.edited`, `hasKit: true` on `volunteer.added`); a ticked person's block wears the chip «Are kit»; the public form has no such box, and a forged one is ignored (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the «Voluntari» strip, then «Cu kit: N» / "With a kit: N" counts the ticked who are not cancelled in the scope — said with a nought too, blind to the state, role and kit filters, a link to `?kit=yes` that the pill in force clears — and the select «Are kit» filters to `yes` or `no`, anything else being no filter; the event editor's «Voluntari» card ends its closed line with the same «Cu kit: N» once anyone active is ticked (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registrations list with one event in scope, then «Kituri de pregătit» adds the line «Plus voluntari cu kit: N» / "Plus volunteers with a kit: N" — that event's volunteers ticked «Are kit», not cancelled — only when N is above nought; the title's figure, `countKits` and every registrations export are unchanged (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event's volunteers' CSV, then its last column is «Are kit» («Da» / «Nu»; "Has a kit", "Yes" / "No" in English), no earlier column moving; the spreadsheet carries it right after the T-shirt's size, the every-event workbook too; and «Toate datele unei persoane» lists «Are kit» among an offer's facts (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event with one role name under two categories, when `/admin/volunteers` lists a person who offered both and was given one, then «S-a oferit pentru» reads «Direcționare (Start / Sosire), Direcționare (Traseu)» and «Roluri date» «Direcționare (Traseu)» — each role once, named with its category as the card names it (`roleLabel`), the role select too — while a role under no category keeps its name alone (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Are kit» on a volunteer, counted as «Cu kit»; the list names a role with its category
